values.facts_found: Today is 2026-09-15 IST. User U112 verified using registered email; order O1012 belongs to U112. Order Delivered on 2026-09-11 at 12:00 IST. Affected item confirmed: I1013, Phone charger, electronics, quantity 1, database item price ₹899. Shipping fee ₹49; payment method UPI. Full refund calculation is ₹948 including shipping, to original UPI payment method. Report is 4 calendar days after delivery, within the 7-day electronics window. No refunds in last 90 days, qualifying count 0, and no prior refunds on this order; shipping has not been refunded. Evidence check confirms no photo uploaded; photo not required by E6 for this ₹899 item. Actual injury is not confirmed; user reports near burn and sparking, an electrical safety hazard. No return or refund has been created, and no compensation has been issued. The order was delivered on its promised date and does not qualify for a late-order coupon. Normal defective-item refund timing under E5 is automatic after pickup, not an immediate agent refund, because item value is ₹899. ₹5,000 compensation is outside permitted compensation under F2.
values.rule_triggered: G2 and G6 require immediate human escalation for an electrical safety hazard/near injury. G3 requires relevant read-only facts and a complete handoff. E13/E3/E12/E7 govern the defective-item full-refund calculation and method; F2 prohibits the requested ₹5,000 compensation.
values.what_user_was_told: Expressed concern, advised stopping use, keeping the charger away from children, disconnecting power only if safe, and seeking medical attention if the child was injured. Told the customer that the electrical safety report requires urgent human escalation and that their full-refund request can be included, but a refund today cannot be promised and ₹5,000 compensation cannot be authorized. Customer then confirmed the affected order and identity details and asked for both requests to be included.
